English: Wooden Palisade
A basic defensive perimeter of sharpened logs and earthworks, hastily constructed to keep out raiders and wild beasts.
Reinforced Gate
A sturdier timber gatehouse with iron bracing and a small guard post, deterring thieves and hostile incursions.
Guard Tower
A wooden watchtower overlooking the approach to the town, improving surveillance and response to threats.
Stone Rampart
A formidable stone wall replaces the old palisade, greatly improving the citys defenses and deterring would-be attackers.
Moat Ditch
A deep ditch and flooded moat dug around the ramparts, making direct assault and siege works much more difficult.
Outer Bailey
A fortified outer courtyard with barracks, workshops, and additional defensive walls, increasing both security and urban capacity.
Machicolated Walls
High stone walls with machicolations, allowing defenders to repel assailants from above with arrows and stones.
Inner Curtain
A second, higher, and thicker inner wall, designed to resist even the most determined siege engines.
Defensive Bastion
Massive stone bastions anchor the citys walls, bristling with arrow slits and platforms for siege engines.
Fortified Citadel
The heart of the city boasts a mighty citadel, serving as the final refuge and command center in times of siege.
